verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking controls are a fair privacy question for a SaaS issue tracker like Linear, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting or mechanism to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. Workspace privacy features such as private teams and access controls are adjacent controls, not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
